event.description: Trade one transformer layer for a wider ff48 sublayer
event.proposal: family: attention organization; current retained incumbent is 3136 parameters at 99.9500%, a +0.95 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0030, per-head block-diagonal output projections at 3200/100.00% before the ff16 reduction; same-family failed result: attempt-0025, d14 MQA width reduction at 2968/9.99%; prior attempts in this family: 6. Hypothesis: the incumbent's two blocks each use a narrow ff16 sublayer, while a single independently parameterized MQA block with ff48 can spend a similar budget on nonlinear width and still attend over the whole fixed sequence, yielding 3008 parameters. This is more informative than repeating the failed tied-block experiment because it removes a depth copy but restores independent parameters and substantially widens the surviving block; the nearest untested alternative is a two-block partial tie, which tests reuse rather than the depth-versus-width tradeoff. Keep d16/h2, independent head-local output maps, MQA, affine-free pre-norms, final affine norm, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3136 parameters.
